lineal_energy.note: Composite dose-mean lineal energy for 10B(n,alpha)7Li capture products; literature-convention value used in MKM cross-checks, order 150-250 keV/um depending on cell geometry.
Composite dose-mean lineal energy for 14N(n,p)14C capture protons (~580 keV); representative literature-convention value.
Composite dose-mean lineal energy for fast-neutron recoil protons; representative literature-convention value.
Composite dose-mean lineal energy for photon secondaries; representative low-LET value.

validity_domain: HSG-like cell linear-quadratic parameters (alpha0 0.172 Gy^-1, beta 0.0615 Gy^-2) in a 1 um tissue-equivalent MKM domain; component lineal energies are literature-convention constants, not fitted spectra. Research cross-model reference — not a clinical model and not a fitted TEPC-based model.
